release_notes:
• Scrubbing now fetches the spot you are dragging to while your finger is still on the bar — the seek lands on bytes already on the device instead of opening a connection after you let go, the same trick that makes big players feel instant
• The decoded audio window is 10 MB (about 30 seconds) instead of 4 MB, so seeks within half a minute are instant, engine-native moves with no network at all
• A slow-but-alive seek is no longer abandoned: while bytes keep arriving the player waits for them; only a stream that stops delivering falls back to the download route
